realWorld.caption: Calibration results on self-collected real data
realWorld.protocol: Per camera, use the common set of observations in which every compared method detects the complete board. Sample40 observations without replacement using the same subset for every method. Repeat100 independently sampled subsets. Report standard deviations of calibrated parameters; reprojection RMSE is computed using mean camera parameters.
realWorld.safe_interpretation: Calibration repeatability and reprojection error on real data. Do not call parameter standard deviation ground-truth accuracy.

synthetic.matched_comparison: Same planar-target pose and camera trajectory per corresponding sequence; target texture changes between checkerboard and circle grid.
synthetic.caveat: E-Calib has a slightly closer mean fy estimate; avoid claiming every mean parameter is closest to ground truth. EventCalib uses an incompatible inverse radial distortion model, so its k1 is not reported.

stereo.real_protocol: Rigid hardware-synchronized stereo rig. Intrinsics estimated per camera from all valid observations. Stereo observations randomly split70% calibration and30% evaluation. e_rect is absolute vertical disparity of corresponding rectified corners on evaluation observations; mean/std over all these correspondences.
stereo.safe_interpretation: 0.58+/-0.19px is the paper-level held-out rectification summary. It is not the statistic of the single displayed W52 example.
